description: Pilot: every Los Angeles Dodgers selection in the 2015 Rule 4 draft (42 picks), plus the later selections of four unsigned 2015 picks who were drafted again. Research date 2026-10-19.

coverage_claims.gap_notes: All 42 selections are tracked (MLB Stats API and Baseball-Reference agree on names and overall picks), and every pick has a signing status (36 signed, 6 did not sign). Held at PARTIAL_RECONSTRUCTION pending review: bonuses are published for only 18 of 36 signed picks, slots only for rounds 1-10, no outcomes audited, Baseball-Reference reached via an archived copy.
